d.ko: OFFBEAT is a music-tycoon game where you build the recording studio of your dreams. Collect and upgrade increasingly strange musical objects, complete jobs for cash, and record real, actual music.
d.en: OFFBEAT is a music-tycoon game where you build the recording studio of your dreams. Collect and upgrade increasingly strange musical objects, complete jobs for cash, and record real, actual music.
d.zh: 《异想节拍》是一款音乐制作模拟经营游戏，你要在这里亲手打造梦寐以求的录音室，获取、升级越来越离奇的音乐道具，接单赚钱，自己动手创作和录制真正的音乐。
